summary: November 13, 2026 review of retained Store-to-Agent and native isolation evidence, followed by bounded native TLS deployment, Linux whole-call performance and installed short-soak/fault recovery runs based on 43020db6 (commit label 3.8.0; compiled package metadata 3.7.8). Narrow verified source, SSH, native TLS, performance and Linux installed-recovery evidence coexists with the original partial integration claims. Qualification remains open beyond the trusted-template and test-fault campaigns. Production accounts, matching GUI/SDK installed journeys, other platform variants, publication and replacement require their own named proof; historical in-process ABI or 1M solver evidence cannot substitute.

qualification_requirements.acceptance: Retain the November 13 real red-to-green registry, direct JSON adapter and ABI export/decode regressions. Reject wrong, blank or padded result identities and success envelopes carrying an error; never relabel a result. This proves attribution, not numerical correctness or arbitrary direct handler calls.

Retain actual source-built Agents rejecting wrong/empty IDs and contradictory success with original task identity, non-retryable failure, child exit and a separate healthy follow-up. Earlier valid template execution alone does not verify bad-result rejection; no current installed App claim follows.

Retain source-native crash, constructor hang, deadline, cancellation, parent SIGKILL and owned-descendant cleanup with healthy next tasks. The group is established before plugin loading. Escaped process groups, hostile native code, host power loss, simultaneous watchdog failure and Windows are outside this bounded verification.

Retain bounded 1024-entry/256-byte pending cancellation, duplicate idempotency, no eviction, atomic one-shot consumption and active/exact cancellation at capacity. Source Agents use local TLS to reject excess IDs, preserve intents across rejected execution admission, consume all retained IDs and run healthy follow-ups. Unit tests prove registration rejection skips package cleanup and cleanup failure does not undo accepted cancellation. Restart explicitly loses these process-local intents; this does not verify durable cancellation, installed GUI/SDK, hostile-client availability, or retention of real job-scoped packages over TLS.

Keep cancellation registration independent of package lifecycle lock admission. A stalled HTTP resolution must not delay cancellation acknowledgment; explicit cleanup returns a typed busy error without mutation, capacity stays occupied until execution exits, then cleanup-only retry and a healthy same-job solve succeed. Unit tests reject poisoned locks and invalid identities. This is not a total fetch/filesystem deadline, actual bound-package retention, TLS contention, installed GUI/SDK, power-loss or Windows qualification.

Terminate and reap a stalled download before terminal failure; verify socket closure, unpublished-generation cleanup including an injected incomplete file, no automatic retry and healthy same-job execution. Exercise header stalls, partial resolution bodies and total timeout without cancellation; unit-test cancellable/bounded lifecycle waiting. This does not qualify HTTPS faults, large real artifact writes, parent loss during download, power loss, installed GUI/SDK, Windows or a hard filesystem deadline.

Observe real 16 MiB partial files from a declared 64 MiB entrypoint before cancellation, HTTP truncation and owned-Agent SIGKILL. Require downloader exit, no publication/replay, startup stale-session removal, and explicit re-fetch/execute of a real template. Separately verify a complete 64 MiB synthetic artifact through Installer without executing it. This does not qualify physical power loss, all orphan/restart races, parallel janitors, HTTPS faults, Windows, installed GUI/SDK or whole-process memory bounds.

Hold a real downloader stopped across owned-Agent SIGKILL and replacement startup; retain its partial file while the independent child lease survives. After child exit, explicit generation preparation reaps the deferred session and executes a real template without harming live peers. Four independently started Agents must claim one stale cleanup exactly once and execute separately. Bound catalog lock waiting, retain the stable lock inode and prevent late child admission from recreating deleted sessions. Not all schedules, mixed binaries, NFS, Windows, power loss or installed GUI/SDK qualification.

Kill owned native test children running production session initialization at ten committed-intent creation boundaries and two cleanup boundaries. Recover matching incomplete metadata non-recursively, retain live leases, foreign or nonempty contents and symlinks. A legacy torn JSON intent without a staging commitment must remain reported; unknown old partial sessions stay untouched. Require idempotent cleanup and independent proof revocation. These test-build barriers do not qualify full Agent startup at every boundary, physical power loss, mixed binaries, network filesystems, Windows, installed GUI/SDK or adversarial concurrent filesystem mutation.

Kill owned test children after staging creation, partial write, file sync, no-replace publication and staging unlink. Recover only reconstructible identity/SHA-256/prefix matches with unambiguous session/final-record state; preserve collisions, corrupt bytes, foreign caches, unexpected sessions, symlinks and active leases. Keep staging and session cleanup counts distinct and idempotent; reject unsafe rename publication in a negative control. Depends on same-directory hard-link support, not authentication against local writers. Excludes power loss, all filesystem failures, concurrent hostile mutation, mixed versions, network filesystems, Windows and installed GUI/SDK acceptance.

Reject target inspection errors before creating an intent. Use an owned subprocess file-size limit to observe a real 96-byte partial staging file without publication or session creation. Inject sync failure only in test builds. Under non-root Unix permissions, deny inspection, publication, staging unlink, initialization commit and incomplete cleanup; preserve existing records/live peers, then restore permission and verify explicit idempotent recovery. Run the ignored permission qualification explicitly. This is not actual ENOSPC, physical sync failure, whole-Agent startup, power loss, all filesystem errors, hostile mutation, NFS, Windows or installed GUI/SDK qualification.

Reproduce metadata loss during legacy whole-root recursive removal under real non-root permission denial. Publish an independent hard link to validated identity without replacement before payload deletion. Test injected failures and owned-child SIGKILL at six publication/payload/lease/marker/directory boundaries; require explicit idempotent cleanup, active-lease retention, no new downloader admission and one concurrent cleanup claim. Qualify real permission denial during payload deletion, record publication and final unlink. Preserve conflicting initialization, malformed/foreign records, unknown root entries and unsafe symlinks; never reclaim legacy unrecorded missing identity. Not every whole-Agent startup boundary, directory-entry power-loss durability, all I/O schedules, hostile mutation, mixed versions, network filesystems, Windows or installed GUI/SDK acceptance.

Reproduce pre-fix normal-close deletion and new preparation/downloader admission despite unresolved initialization, plus retired/prepared generation deletion despite unresolved records, changed session identity or a busy catalog. Share final/staging/retirement rules; keep identity checks and owned-generation deletion under the same catalog lock. Verify no blocked preparation, explicit retry after resolution, existing lease survival, healthy peer independence, valid-but-uncommitted initialization, abandoned-generation restart reclamation and normal-close retention. Reject file/symlink record namespaces and real non-root unreadable initialization directories. Publish diagnostics before returning a preparation error. This is cleanup admission, not generation-internal partial-deletion recovery, revocation of execution, hostile filesystem races, mixed versions, physical power loss, network filesystems, Windows or installed GUI/SDK journeys.

Before payload deletion retain a no-replace sibling hard link to the validated generation identity under session catalog coordination. Resume errors and owned-child SIGKILL at five record/payload/marker/root boundaries; require real non-root permission failures at payload deletion, publication, root removal and final record unlink. Keep queued ownership after final unlink failure, deny late downloader attachment, preserve active peers and reject ambiguous or legacy missing identities. Missing marker is permitted only with a valid record and an empty root. Abandoned preparations recover after session closure, not through live orphan adoption. Excludes every whole-Agent boundary, live retries for dropped preparations, Windows sharing errors, hostile mutation, all I/O errors, physical power loss, network filesystems, mixed versions and installed GUI/SDK qualification.

Reproduce dropped-preparation cleanup remaining unreclaimed on the next preparation, then retain immutable identity in a session-owned queue. Reuse lifecycle/catalog checks for bounded, deduplicated, rotating batches; retry while idle and before preparation without downloading or executing work. Verify all five partial-cleanup boundaries, worker restart and spawn-failure fallback, healthy active-generation protection, ambiguous identity and lifecycle retention, real non-root permission repair, and weak-reference session release with stale-session fallback. Excludes Windows, installed GUI/SDK acceptance, arbitrary thread panic, hostile mutation, physical power loss, mixed versions, network filesystems and all I/O schedules. The retry interval does not bound filesystem operation duration.

Preserve the November 13 two-host Installer-managed empty-store journey: stage a real Linux template, explicit project enablement, upload via a verified SSH loopback tunnel, pending restart, explicit managed restart, digest-bound ready and sum=14, plus conflict without replacement. This predates the later isolation regressions and is not a fresh current-build rerun, native TLS, Linux ARM64, Store account or installed GUI journey.

Use an authorized test account and registered public client against the deployed HTTPS issuer with verified CA. Qualify browser registration handoff, callback identity, expiry, refresh, logout/revocation and stale-session rejection without exposing tokens. Isolated HTTPS fixtures and registration links do not close real account acceptance.

Qualify real entitlement denial, consent, one idempotent quota grant, signed fixed-platform download, expired session, lost grant reply and App reopen using independent trust pins. Verify no duplicate quota consumption or cross-account reuse. Test-signed fixtures or staging uploads are not public authorized download proof.

Install an actually published package with independently provisioned verification key, exact platform/digests and revocation checks. Preserve denial and interrupted install evidence without consuming another grant. Isolated local signing tests, retained old package installation and backend draft sealing cannot certify this production-source chain.

Through the matching installed shell, frontend and runtime, perform the GUI and actual WASM PWDT project flow from exact catalog reference to platform staging, enablement, remote readiness, execution and explicit recovery. Lost replies, logout and context changes must preserve identity without blind replay. Browser bridge mocks, host Python and separate native tests do not form this whole journey.

Repeat actual cross-host upload, response-loss reconciliation, explicit restart and execution over native TLS with verified server identity and Agent token. Exercise credential denial/rotation and process identity replacement; do not send Store credentials to Agent. The verified SSH tunnel path and local TLS gateway tests remain separate evidence.

Build a real Linux ARM64 library and run it on a matching Agent with ABI/system-library compatibility, exact digest readiness, execution, fault rejection and healthy follow-up. ELF header fixtures and Linux x86_64 execution cannot qualify ARM64.

Qualify current Windows native process-tree ownership and termination, including descendants, constructor faults, hang, cancellation and parent loss, then a healthy distinct task. Current direct-child cleanup and historical Windows in-process ABI smoke are not Job Object/tree lifecycle qualification.

Package and install the current per-call isolation implementation through Installer into disposable owned services, then repeat source fault/result-admission cases, authority/receipt checks and healthy tasks using matching GUI/SDK artifacts. Earlier installation and later separate source tests do not imply installed closure; avoid restarting daily services for calibration.

Measure complete isolated-call latency including spawn, load, IPC, result validation and cleanup; record repeated p50/p95, throughput, memory/process/descriptor peaks and saturation recovery on representative small/large payloads. Test-only single cases, old resident-host ABI timing and 1M solver-node benchmarks cannot substitute.

Carry enabled package/platform pins with a movable project bundle, preflight dependencies, explicitly replace a conflicting version through managed lifecycle and recover to a usable exact identity without overwriting active packages or accumulating backups. Conflict rejection and local-only enablement are implemented boundaries, not migration/replacement functionality.

Expose and verify the new native workspace deployment contract in separately distributed Rust, Python and Elixir Headless packages: exact platform/process pins, bounded chunks, reply-loss inspect, conflict/activation failure and no automatic restart. Existing general language parity and the workspace Rust helper do not qualify this new API. PWDT remains a separate GUI control surface.

Connect an enabled project Store pin to an independently authorized Orchestra catalog admission/readiness receipt, then dispatch to its bound Agent which pulls only the needed exact package. Preserve single-controller authority and lost-reply recovery. The old bound-Orchestra fetch test and new direct upload path do not imply their project supply-chain integration; Store remains distribution, never execution control.

Retain real target-native build/test artifacts, exact manifest/library mapping and author upload/resume/finalize followed by independent signature review and explicit publication. Run on each supported target rather than counting synthetic headers. The isolated macOS package backend sealing exercise does not close public submission, review approval or multi-platform execution.

Qualify current independently built plugin/host pairs with stable JSON C ABI, matching allocator/free behavior, valid old package compatibility, malformed results and explicit faults in the new per-call execution model. Preserve old ABI receipts at their original revisions; they cannot certify new isolation behavior across every target or malicious-code containment.
